item.title: Version 0.2.9
item.description:
• Save (⌘S) keeps you in the editor on the saved version; Done closes it.
  • Nothing typed while a save is running is lost any more.
  • Dragging a file onto another project's folder no longer moves that project's file with the same path.
  • Sync, push, conflict resolution and branch switches of one project no longer run at the same time.
  • Adding or closing projects quickly no longer leaves a second indexer running.
  • Git no longer hangs on long error output, and the server switch no longer reports a busy port during start.

item.title: Version 0.2.8
item.description:
- Doc Health screen: agents report wrong, outdated, missing or unclear docs, and you resolve them in the app.

- Doc Health also shows searches that found nothing good (missing docs), the most used docs, and near-duplicate passages.

- A warning before you edit a file someone changed on the remote.

- The document header stays on top while the body scrolls.

- Folder tiles wrap onto more lines.

- Switching projects no longer shows the previous project's documents, and backlinks only come from documents that really link here.

- Long titles no longer push the window content under the toolbar.

item.title: Version 0.2.7
item.description:
Code and text files open in Hivemind: Java, Python, YAML, JSON, logs and more, with syntax highlighting in every theme.

Edit them in a plain-text editor that saves exactly what you typed and keeps the file's line endings.

Notes is now called Documents.

item.title: Version 0.2.6
item.description:
Capture screen removed: write notes with New Note (dictation is in the editor), log quick thoughts and links in the Journal.

Deleting the open note no longer shows a Note not found error; Hivemind shows its folder instead.

item.title: Version 0.2.5
item.description:
OpenCode: automatic tickets (Help -> Connect -> Set Up OpenCode); tickets are saved in each project's docs/tickets.

Much lower CPU and memory: no more endless background animation; long notes scroll smoothly.

Copy Title on notes and tickets; corrected Help and team setup steps.

item.title: Version 0.2.4
item.description:
MCP sessions survive Hivemind restarts and updates; agents no longer hang after an update.

Long notes no longer block other writes, and searches stay fast while a project indexes.

Agents can use paths without vault/ and see which projects are open.

item.title: Version 0.2.2
item.description:
Updates now come from a public releases repository, so no GitHub token is needed. The saved token is removed.

Private notes were removed from the app; notes marked private elsewhere stay hidden from agents.
